title: Starter Helm visual drivers: hero map + snapshot collage for Quickstart
creator: Claire Nguyen
description: Design and deliver a fresh hero and supporting visual system for the Quickstart landing page called 'Starter Helm'. This ticket covers a hero 'map' that orients users to the four onboarding paths, a responsive snapshot collage showing product screens in device frames, and updated microcopy that reads clearly at first glance. The work should produce Figma comps, export-ready PNG/SVG assets for the marketing and docs teams, and a screenshot checklist for engineering to replicate in end-to-end tests.
deliverables: Snapshot collage variants: 3x device-frame compositions (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Microcopy set for hero headline, subhead, CTA, and progressive step labels
Exported assets: SVG hero map, optimized PNG snapshots (2x, 3x), and a transparent background collage
Screenshot checklist and annotation sheet for PM/Engineering
Handoff package in Figma with tokenized colors and spacing spec
acceptance_criteria: Hero map visually communicates the four onboarding paths within 2 seconds of viewing
Collage scales gracefully at 320px, 768px, and 1280px widths without content overlap
Microcopy passes UX review and legal sanity check; no more than 120 characters in headline
Assets exported and uploaded to Drive with correct naming conventions: Quickstart_Hero_SVG_v1.svg etc.
Screenshot checklist validated by engineering on staging and added to QA runbook
visual_spec_notes: Use the brand accent gradient subtly behind the hero map to keep contrast low for text legibility. Device frames are reduced-ornament style (no heavy drop shadows) and use a 2px stroke from the neutral-700 token. The hero map uses four waypoint icons derived from existing iconography but simplified for small screens. Max headline width: 640px on desktop. Body text size should remain 16px on mobile with 1.3 line-height.
screenshot_checklist: Log into staging account and complete first-run flow to 'Create API key' screen
Capture token-labeled screenshot with redaction on sensitive fields
Reproduce example request/response panel for 'Text generation' sample
Take network-less snapshot for offline marketing use (no real keys in view)
Verify screenshots in dark mode and light mode variants
decisions: Use a map-with-waypoints metaphor rather than a single illustration to highlight multiple entry points
Prioritize neutral color palette with a single accent gradient to avoid clashing with customer screenshots
Combine device-frame collage with isolated full-bleed hero image on tablet breakpoint for emphasis
blockers: Awaiting final copy approval from PM (Marco Rodriguez)
Backend team needs to expose a safe demo endpoint for screenshot reproducibility
Legal review queued for claims in hero subhead
